task.description:
Validate the CODE-DESIGNER design at src/design/service-task-test-capture-server.md, which fixes the flaky TC-EXT-01-U08a test (GH #528 / ISS-0207): CaptureServer hardcoded port 18181 + a cross-thread data race reading captured headers before the server thread finished writing them. Confirm the design covers both root causes and contains no implementation code.

RE-CHECK: CODE-DESIGNER has reworked the design per your BLOCKER/MINOR findings (rework 1/3) — std.Thread.ResetEvent replaced with std.Io.Event throughout, port accessor corrected to server.socket.address / listener.socket.address. Re-validate from scratch, including re-checking the std.Io.Event API against lib/std/Io.zig yourself.
acceptance_criteria: Design covers ephemeral port binding (port 0) + dynamic url_template construction, replacing the hardcoded 18181
Design covers a happens-before synchronisation primitive between the CaptureServer thread and the test assertions, replacing defer-at-scope-exit
No implementation code (compilable Zig) present in the design artefact
Design is complete enough for BACKEND-DEV to implement without further clarification
